title: Determinantal Point Process Approximation under Positive and Negative Dependence
summary: Determinantal point processes (DPPs) are widely used as probabilistic models for diverse random subsets, but their approximation error under model misspecification has not been fully characterized. We study the population-level approximation of a strictly positive target distribution p* by DPPs under the forward Kullback-Leibler divergence.
